## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] The change keeps KAFKA passive: no exploitation, brute force, credential collection,
      form submission, crawling, stealth or bypass features
- [ ] No secrets, scan reports, history databases or personal data are included
